sections.title: Industrial-Grade Management for Modern AI Labs
sections.body: The Kenya AI Compute Customer Dashboard is designed for the rigorous needs of professional data scientists and infrastructure leads. We don't just show you a bill; we show you the raw performance data of your clusters. From real-time GPU thermal mapping and power draw (allowing you to verify our PUE 1.3 efficiency) to precise billing metrics for your 'Spot' and 'Reserved' instances. Our console provides a seamless bridge between your development environment and our physical hardware in Kenya. You can scale your storage volumes, configure dedicated network segments, and set up automated alerts for model training completion—all from a single, intuitive web interface. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models. Each phase includes checkpoints on capacity, uptime, and unit economics so stakeholders can track progress with confidence. sections.title: Dashboard Features
items: Instance Monitor: Real-time CPU/GPU load, RAM usage, and IOPS.

Billing Center: View current spend, credits, and download tax invoices.
